title: Close v1
description: Companion schema for spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 3. The root schema validates a Close record per the Evidence Layer's reconcile model (draft-mih-agent-evidence-layer-00.md section 'Reconcile and Close'): period, counts by kind, and the head digest at close time, with an optional reconcile block. The same schema serves both a single-store period Close (reconcile absent) and capsule-emit-mesh's two-party Close (reconcile.peer_close cites the other side's Close record) -- one shape, not a parallel family. epistemic_type is fixed to producer_claim: a Close is the store's own statement about its own history, never self-certifying its own AGREED/UNILATERAL/CONTESTED status (that status is read from acknowledges/rebuts links pointing AT this record, per the owning document; reconcile.status below is a reporting convenience, not the authoritative source).

ReconcileTallies.description: The Evidence Layer's six-state reconcile vocabulary (section 'Reconcile and Close'), mirrored here, never redefined. One_only/other_only are not disagreement; only CONFLICTING is.

counts_by_kind.description: Record count by record_type over the period, e.g. {"observation": 12, "evaluation-report": 3}. Open keys -- record_type is itself an open token (Evidence Layer, section 'The Record Model').
